# shopify_privacy_settings (Resource)

The shop's privacy features, which Shopify runs for you until you turn them off. Use it when the shop has its own consent banner: Shopify's banner has to be off before `shopify_consent_policy` can be written, so add `depends_on` there. **Turning a feature off is one-way through the API.** Destroy only removes the resource from state and never touches a feature. If someone turns a feature back on in the admin, the next apply turns it off again. Import with `default`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Turn off Shopify's cookie banner because the shop runs its own consent banner.
# This is one-way through the API; turning it back on happens in the Shopify admin.
# Unset attributes are not managed.
resource "shopify_privacy_settings" "this" {
  cookie_banner_auto_managed = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cookie_banner_auto_managed` (Boolean) Whether Shopify still runs the cookie banner. Set `false` to turn it off. **It can only be turned off:** the Admin API has no way to turn it back on, so `true` fails when the feature is off, and turning it back on happens in the Shopify admin. Unset means not managed.
- `data_sale_opt_out_page_auto_managed` (Boolean) Whether Shopify still runs the data sale opt-out page. Set `false` to turn it off. **It can only be turned off:** the Admin API has no way to turn it back on, so `true` fails when the feature is off, and turning it back on happens in the Shopify admin. Unset means not managed.
- `privacy_policy_auto_managed` (Boolean) Whether Shopify still runs the privacy policy. Set `false` to turn it off. **It can only be turned off:** the Admin API has no way to turn it back on, so `true` fails when the feature is off, and turning it back on happens in the Shopify admin. Unset means not managed.

### Read-Only

- `cookie_banner_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the cookie banner is shown. Informational.
- `id` (String) Shop GID: the privacy settings have no ID of their own.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The shop has one set of privacy settings
terraform import shopify_privacy_settings.this default
```
